svg.text: Lookup wall time, warm, p50 of 20 (plan, plan + read, full scan, DuckDB)
Planning with the index and reading only the planned row groups beat a full scan in 0 of 42 lookups and DuckDB in 0 of 42; the plan alone (one bellwether
process) took 83 ms at the median, of which 4 ms is starting any bellwether process.
lookup_p50_ms_warm (ms). Apple M3 Pro, 12 cores, 36 GiB, macOS 26.4.1, local SSD. DuckDB v2.0.0 (Cyanoptera) d54cbbe3df; bellwether release build of sources at f809e5403d08 (rustc 1.99.1; sha256
3f05ece30dc0); bellwether-bench byte-counting reader in the same binary, sources at f809e5403d08. Measured 2026-10-26.
